answer: At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a mesa tag. The basalt cap is upheld at intake and forge reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The fee repeats 17 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
